units.source_text: “我以为这一手就封盘呢，可是还能下……还能劈头盖脑地下，真吃不消啊。

en.t: I thought this move would seal the game, but he can still play... and he can still come crashing down on me move after move. I really cannot take it.

units.source_text: 再没有什么比再下累人的了。”

en.t: There is nothing more exhausting than having to keep playing.
